verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments platform that processes card transactions, so ML fraud scoring and custom block/review/allow rules are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents neither. The only related item is a pre-sale customer credit-score lookup, which is an adjacent credit-check feature, not transaction fraud scoring or a rules engine.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
